messages.author: c3a159d12f0141eb
messages.subject: Some questions about methylKit.
parts:
Hi,
I've searched discussion group and still can't find answers for my questions. 

The first question is: I have 1 control sample and 3 test samples.The 3 test samples are produced by the same procedures applied to the control sample. It seems I could do this:
sample_list <- list(control1,test1,test2,test3)
meth<-methRead(sample_list,
          sample.id=list("ctrl1","test1","test2","test3"),
          assembly="hg19",
          treatment=c(0,1,1,1),
          context="CpG",
          pipeline = "bismarkCytosineReport",
          header=FALSE,
          mincov = 1)
Then I'd like to use min.per.group=2L in unite(). Obviously the command above cannot be used. 

So I change it to this:
sample_list <- list(control1,control1,control1,test1,test2,test3)
meth<-methRead(sample_list,
          sample.id=list("ctrl1","ctrl1","ctrl1","test1","test2","test3"),
          assembly="hg19",
          treatment=c(0,0,0,1,1,1),
          context="CpG",
          pipeline = "bismarkCytosineReport",
          header=FALSE,
          mincov = 1)
meth_unite=unite(regioncounts, min.per.group =2L)
I wonder if this change is ok.

The second question is:
According to this  https://groups.google.com/d/msg/methylkit_discussion/_6LlMiPH_98/96gaF0EBeoMJ
Does setting weighted.mean=FALSE in calculateDiffMeth() account for the tiles or regions now ?

Thank you very much!

So I change it to this:
